name: ATOM-DIET-TRAJECTORY-1
note: Machine-readable form of PRE-REG ATOM-DIET-TRAJECTORY-1 (RESULTS L66546), written with the prose entry before any birth. Bars, claim axes and receipts mirror the prose; the prose governs on any conflict.

stock.description: stock enc, 15,420 steps, seeds 5/6/7; the no-op leg of the augmentation path

atoms.description: stock rows + frozen shard data/micromodel_atoms_shard0.jsonl (3.5% one-ply atom dose), same 15,420 steps, seeds 5/6/7

bars.name: S1-PROFILE-SEPARATES
bars.description: min over seeds of ||P8_atoms - P8_stock|| strictly exceeds the max of the six within-arm P8 displacements at snapshot 15,420

bars.name: S1b-DIRECTION-REPRODUCES
bars.description: all three treatment vectors nonzero and all three pairwise cosines > 0; zero or undefined books NO-FIRE

bars.name: S2-CLASS-SHARE-SEPARATES
bars.description: the S1 law on the eight-class share vector C8

bars.name: S3-CENTROID-SIGN
bars.description: sign(centroid_atoms - centroid_stock) nonzero and identical at 3/3 seeds, either direction

bars.name: F1-LIFT-REPRODUCES
bars.description: atoms_total > stock_total at 3/3 seeds AND mean paired delta >= +5, final snapshot gate only (the L29465 clause; AMENDMENT -SEAL)

bars.name: F2-L4-REPRODUCES
bars.description: atoms L4 >= stock L4 at 3/3 seeds

refuted_if: STRUCTURAL NO-FIRE with FUNCTION FIRE at six births

registered_prior.F1: fires, mean paired delta +4 to +7, point +5
registered_prior.S1: NO-FIRE, point ratio min T_s / max within-arm displacement 0.9
registered_prior.S3: fires, atoms centroid above stock at 3/3
registered_prior.F2: fires; atoms L4 mean 10 to 13, point 12; stock L4 5 to 9, point 7

stopping: no outcome-based early stopping; operational fail-closed aborts only (source-invariant, stream digest, shard sha, disk < 15 GB, non-finite loss, existing real path, code_commit drift, state_digest inequality)
